description: Listings in a Poshmark closet by username or URL, with department, category, brand, size, color, price, condition, shipping, availability and sort filters. 1 point per returned record.

availability.description: Availability. Options: all = All, available = Available, available_and_dropping_soon = Available and dropping soon, dropping_soon = Dropping soon, sold = Sold, not_for_sale = Not for sale

condition.description: Condition. Options: all = All conditions, nwt = New with tags (NWT)

department.description: Department. Options: Women = Women, Men = Men, Kids = Kids, Home = Home, Electronics = Electronics, Pets = Pets, Beauty & Wellness = Beauty & Wellness

domain.description: Domain. Options: poshmark.com = poshmark.com, poshmark.ca = poshmark.ca Default: poshmark.com.

shipping.description: Shipping. Options: free = Free shipping, discounted = Discounted shipping

sort.description: Sort by. Options: relevance = Relevance, just_in = Just in, price_low_to_high = Price: low to high, price_high_to_low = Price: high to low

user.description: Username or closet URL. e.g. Username or closet URL, e.g. najescloset

name: run_poshmark_users_items
title: Poshmark user items
